label: C2 from power grounding, correlation, passive-to-receptive, no self-esse-cause and B3 (inference)
rule: Case analysis on the power-grounding disjunction; distinctness by no self-esse-cause
meaning: Take a being x contingent at w. By PGP it is corruptible simply or some y has power over its esse. If corruptible, passive-to-receptive makes it existentially receptive. If y has power over its esse, correlation makes x corruptible (receptive again) or makes y a CAUSE_2 of x's esse; were y = x, x would cause its own being, against the existing no-self-esse-cause statement, so y is distinct and, by B3, simply prior. Constructive: no excluded middle.
